text:
Ask a database questions without holding its password. Run one SQL statement on a MySQL, PostgreSQL or ClickHouse database. The database enforces read mode; separate accounts enforce the write and admin tiers. In single-account mode both use DB_USER. Start with query and a SELECT.
query <sql...>: Get rows back, or the affected row count, from one SQL statement using the configured database account.; returns: columns and rows, or the affected row count
  sql (string): One SQL statement

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/db.md
More: agent-bus help <name> config | secret | json

port.help: Database port; the engine's usual one when absent

socket.help: Unix socket path (MySQL and PostgreSQL) instead of host

secrets.name: DB_USER
secrets.help: One account for every caller (only read is then enforced by the database); not needed when per-tier accounts are set

secrets.name: DB_READ_USER
secrets.help: Per-tier accounts: set any, and a tier without one is refused
